subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Spurn
solution:
The correct answer is "**Despise**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Spurn: To reject with disdain or contempt. (तिरस्कार या घृणा के साथ अस्वीकार करना।)
 
• For Example: He spurned the offer to join the new project because he didn't agree with the company's policies.
 
• Despise: To feel contempt or a deep repugnance for. (घृणा या तिरस्कार करना।)
 
• For Example: She despises dishonesty in all its forms.

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: Include (शामिल करना)-To make someone or something part of a group or set.
 
• For Example: The committee decided to include more community members in the planning process.
 
• Option 3: Admire (प्रशंसा करना) -To regard with respect or warm approval.
 
• For Example: I admire her dedication to environmental causes.
 
• Option 4: Gossip (गपशप)- Casual or unconstrained conversation or reports about other people, typically involving details that are not confirmed as true.
 
• For Example: They spent the afternoon gossiping about their neighbors.
